meta.name: pestel-delta-monitor
meta.description: Quarterly re-scan of a prior PESTEL analysis. Use when checking which macro factors moved, which assumptions broke, and what's new — turning PESTEL from a workshop artifact into a radar.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 定期扫描宏观环境变化，更新PESTEL分析
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果定期需要追踪宏观因素变化并更新战略假设。
copy.tagline_en: Rescan macro environment changes and update PESTEL analysis quarterly
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to track macro factor shifts and update strategic assumptions regularly.

howto.what: 装上后:用上一次 PESTEL 为基线,逐项比对六类宏观因素,只报告实际发生的变化,标出被推翻的旧假设和新增因素,输出带引用和置信度的增量报告。
howto.when: 当你给出上一次 PESTEL 分析并追问期间宏观环境有何变化、哪些假设失效或有什么新情况时触发;没有基线时会先建议做初次 PESTEL 分析。

say.text: 这是 Q1 的 PESTEL,看看现在哪些因素变了。
say.note: Claude 会逐项比对并输出增量报告。

say.text: 针对这份基线,哪些老假设已被新证据推翻?
say.note: 报告会把破裂假设单列出来。

say.text: 我们行业刚通过一项新法规,按基线重扫一次 PESTEL。
say.note: 会先核对该法规是否属实再写入报告。

howto.what_en: Uses the prior PESTEL analysis as a baseline, diffs the six macro factor categories, reports only material changes, highlights assumptions now contradicted by evidence, and outputs a cited delta report with confidence labels.
howto.when_en: When you supply a prior PESTEL and ask what has changed, which assumptions broke, or what is new; without a baseline, it recommends running an initial PESTEL first.

say_en.text: Here's the Q1 PESTEL — what's changed since then?
say_en.note: It diffs each factor and returns a delta report.

say_en.text: Against this baseline, which assumptions are now contradicted by evidence?
say_en.note: Those are listed as broken assumptions.

say_en.text: A new regulation just passed in our space — re-run the scan against the baseline.
say_en.note: It checks the regulation is real before including it.
